caption: Color corrected previous work (not done by me) that turned grey/ blue.  It’s important to ask your practitioner what type of pigment is being used (organic, inorganic, or hybrid) as each has different longevity.  The quality of pigment is equally, if not more important….too much carbon black in pigment can result in blue grey brows over time.

Thank you Chelsea @chelcgo for trusting me with your brows.  As a PMU artist herself, she specifically requested soft & subtle shading with minimal enhancement at the front of the brows.  #pmubrows #powderedbrows #pmu #pmuartist
